## Why This Is Asked
Assesses practical CI gating, SBOM generation, and license compliance in a mono-repo.

## Key Concepts
- SBOM generation with Syft
- SPDX license checks and whitelisting
- Per-service CI gates in a mono-repo
- Interpreting SBOM/license failures

## Code Example
```yaml
name: SBOM and License Gate
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]
jobs:
  gate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Build image
        run: |
          echo "build service image"
      - name: Generate SBOM
        run: |
          syft image:myorg/service:sha -o json > sbom.json
      - name: Upload SBOM
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: sbom.json
          path: sbom.json
      - name: License check
        run: |
          if on_disallowed_license; then exit 1; fi
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you adapt for multi-service prerequisites?
- How would you auto-fix or report to maintainers?

## Code Example

```yaml
name: prod-provenance
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - manifests/prod/**
jobs:
  gate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: setup cosign
        run: |
          curl -sSfL https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/releases/download/v1.10.0/cosign-linux-amd64 -o cosign
          chmod +x cosign
          sudo mv cosign /usr/local/bin/

          cosign verify -key cosign.pub registry.example.com/namespace/service:tag
      - name: verify SBOM attestation
        run: |
          cyclone_dx_attest --image registry.example.com/namespace/service:tag --attest
```

- How to scale SBOM checks across many services and environments?

## Why This Is Asked
GPU ML clusters rely on kernel modules from a private registry; enforcing integrity at load time is critical to prevent tampering.

## Key Concepts
- cosign signing and Rekor attestations
- load-time attestation verification
- policy enforcement via OPA/Kyverno

```bash
cosign sign -key cosign.key path/to/module.ko
cosign sign -key cosign.key path/to/module.json
cosign verify path/to/module.ko
```

```bash
# OPA snippet
package kernel.authz

violation[{"msg": msg}] {
  input.attestation.subject == "module.ko"
  not input.attestation.issuer in ["approved-issuer-A","approved-issuer-B"]
  msg := "unapproved module attestation"
}
```

```yaml
# Kyverno policy (simplified)
apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy
metadata: { name: attested-modules }
spec:
  rules:
  - id: require-attested-modules
    match: { any: [{ context: { name: "kernel-loader" } }] }
    validate:
      message: "Module must be attested"
      pattern:
        any: true
```

Checks for API deprecation are common, and beginner-friendly gates show practical CI thinking without complex tooling.

- K8s API version deprecations

## Code Example

```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
for f in k8s/**/*.yaml; do
  if grep -E \"apiVersion:\s*(extensions/v1beta1|apps/v1beta1|networking.k8s.io/v1beta1)\" \"$f\" >/dev/null; then
    echo \"Deprecated apiVersion found in $f\"
    exit 1
  fi
done
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to design a scalable, automated policy gate across multi-cloud clusters using Gatekeeper/OPA, Cosign attestations, and runtime security constraints.

## Key Concepts

- Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate and Constraint
- Cosign attestation and image provenance
- Registry allowlist and image provenance checks
- Pod security: runAsNonRoot, readOnlyRootFilesystem, drop capabilities
- CI integration and gatekeeper audit verification

## Code Example

```yaml
# ConstraintTemplate (Gatekeeper) minimal sketch
apiVersion: templates.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1
kind: ConstraintTemplate
metadata:
  name: k8ssecuredcontainers
spec:
  crd:
    spec:
      names:
        kind: K8sSecuredContainers
  targets:
    - target: admission.k8s.gatekeeper.sh
      rego: |
        package k8ssecuredcontainers
        
        violation[{"msg": msg}] {
          container := input.review.object.spec.containers[_]
          not signed(container.image)
          msg := sprintf("Container image %v must be cosign-signed", [container.image])
        }
        
        violation[{"msg": msg}] {
          container := input.review.object.spec.containers[_]
          not allowed_registry(container.image)
          msg := sprintf("Registry %v not in allowlist", [container.image])
        }
        
        violation[{"msg": msg}] {
          container := input.review.object.spec.containers[_]
          not container.securityContext.runAsNonRoot
          msg := "Container must run as non-root"
        }
```

apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
